summary.title: Scenario 2 - Third Party Payment API Integration
summary.description: An e-commerce platform that integrates with a third-party payment gateway via REST API using API keys. Transaction results are stored in an internal database and displayed to customers. Order confirmation emails are sent through a third-party email service.

diagrams.title: Payment Transaction Flow
diagrams.description: Data flow diagram showing payment processing, third-party API integration, database storage, and email notification flow.
